test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which organisation launched the Indian Customs Compliance Information Portal (CIP) for providing free access to information on all Customs procedures and regulatory compliance for nearly 12,000 Customs Tariff items in the year 2021?

options.text: Central Board for Indirect Taxes & Customs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Board for Indirect Taxes & Customs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Central Board for Indirect Taxes & Customs** (CBIC) launched the Indian Customs Compliance Information Portal (CIP) in 2021.
 
• The portal provides free access to information on all Customs procedures and regulatory compliance for nearly 12,000 Customs Tariff items.
